pick.headline: Reagan and Gorbachev meet at Reykjavik
pick.summary: On October 11-12, 1986, Ronald Reagan and Mikhail Gorbachev met at Reykjavik and came close to agreeing to abolish ballistic missiles before deadlocking over the Strategic Defense Initiative.
pick.significance: The summit failed at the time but laid the groundwork for the INF Treaty of 1987.
